findings.explanation: The APC high-precision load object is believed to be `upsHighPrecOutputLoad`, reported in tenths of a percent. If so, the name is wrong and merging it with whole-percent `upsAdvOutputLoad` needs a /10 scale.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the exact object name and unit in PowerNet-MIB and state the scaling needed to normalise the two fields.

findings.explanation: The SPL evaluates one 30-minute bucket at a time and has no two-bucket condition or per-host throttle.
findings.quote: Alert when sustained `avg_load > 80` for two successive 30-minute buckets or instantaneous `peak_load > 90`
findings.suggested_fix: Match the text to the SPL (any single bucket with avg_load above 80 or peak_load above 90), or extend the SPL to require two consecutive buckets.

findings.explanation: The same text elsewhere says to use `dispatch.earliest_time` of -15m, to poll every 1 to 5 minutes, and later to use a default of 300 to 900 seconds. These windows and cadences contradict each other, and a -15m window cannot hold two 30-minute buckets.
findings.quote: Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages.
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one polling interval and one search window that covers the 30-minute buckets, and delete the generic boilerplate Steps 2 to 5.

findings.explanation: `/Forms/login2` looks like the NMC login form path, not a load display. Check the actual NMC page that shows output load.
findings.quote: validate against the NMC web UI `/Forms/login2` measured load pane
findings.suggested_fix: Give the real NMC menu path for output load, or just say to compare with the NMC front-page load reading.

findings.explanation: Check the SC4SNMP documentation: it is deployed on Docker or Kubernetes, not as an app on a heavy forwarder. The same applies to the claim in dataSources that events normalise to `sourcetype=snmp:apc:ups`.
findings.quote: on a Docker host or heavy forwarder
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the supported SC4SNMP deployment and the sourcetype it emits.

findings.explanation: Contradicts the preceding SC4SNMP and SNMP Modular Input description. Splunkbase 617 is not in the cached catalogue and the Universal Forwarder is not a Splunkbase app.
findings.quote: Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the Universal Forwarder sentence from `dataSources` and `app`.

findings.explanation: Redis has nothing to do with APC UPS load monitoring through SNMP.
The SPL uses no KV lookups, and neither role nor the `ups_rated_kva.csv` file is used by the detection.
findings.quote: Restrict KV lookups that map rack IDs via RBAC role `power_ops_admin` for edits and `snmp_inventory_read` for analysts.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the unused lookup and role guidance, or add the lookup to the SPL.

findings.explanation: Search-time filters do not reduce licence consumption, which is metered on indexed volume.
findings.quote: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost
findings.suggested_fix: Say early filters speed up the search.

summary: A well-targeted APC load UC with a correct OID for `upsAdvOutputLoad`, but the implementation and scheduling text conflict with the SPL and with each other, and a few APC facts need checking.
